# v1.0 — native audio, HEVC and 4K, TV Game Mode

First stable release of the native Moonlight client for Samsung TVs running **Tizen 5.0** (Muse.M, armv7l). Since v0.2 the engine **plays the sound natively**, **HEVC and 4K** are verified on the TV, **TV Game Mode** works end to end, and the video latency is lower.

[![demo (v0.2)](https://img.youtube.com/vi/dFGEaQFeYeA/maxresdefault.jpg)](https://youtu.be/dFGEaQFeYeA)

## What is new since v0.2

- **Native audio** (core #37): the engine decodes Opus and plays the PCM through the TV's audio-io, with no message-port hop. Stereo 48 kHz, verified on a TV (`audio route: native` in the logs): fewer dropouts and a faster gamepad than with Web Audio. Web Audio stays as an automatic fallback (5.1 streams, or when audio-io fails).
- **HEVC and 4K** verified on the TV.
- **Lower video latency** (core #40): `nudge` pacing is the default for 60 fps streams (target 100 ms, `mlTargetDepth(ms)` in the console); a missing H.264 SPS `bitstream_restriction` is added; a one-time catch-up of the player queue after the start (core #34).
- **TV Game Mode** (core #32, #34, #41, #42): on at the stream start, off at the stop, and still off after you leave Moonlight. The UI repeats a call the TV refused (`rc -2`). If the TV stays in game mode after the app was closed mid-stream, switch it off from the console: `mlGameMode(false, 1)`, then `mlGameMode(false, 0)` (see the README).
- **Gamepad stop combo** Back+Start+LB+RB leaves the stream (tested with an Xbox controller).
- **Stats overlay over the video** (core #40), turned on by the UI's performance statistics setting (core #34).
- **Fixes** (core #34): the player is closed after a failed setup, more data in the `ML-ERROR` line; the host self-tests run in CI on every pull request.
- Packages now carry the release version (`1.0.0`) in their manifests.

## What works (verified on real hardware)

- **Full streaming session**: host discovery (mDNS) or manual add, PIN pairing with Sunshine / GFE / Wolf, app list, launch.
- **Hardware video** through the TV's ES player: H.264 720p–1080p at up to 60 fps, HEVC, 4K.
- **Native audio** (audio-io), Web Audio fallback.
- **Xbox controller over Bluetooth**: buttons, sticks, analog triggers; Back+Start+LB+RB leaves the stream.
- **Remote Back key leaves the stream** and returns to the app list.
- **TV Game Mode** during a stream.
- **Diagnostics**: every failure produces one `ML-ERROR` line with the session config, counters and player state.

## Install

Install **both** packages with [Apps2Samsung](https://github.com/Apps2Samsung/Apps2Samsung) (it reads the TV's DUID and signs for it):

- `Moonlight-1.0.wgt` — the web UI
- `org.moonlight.host-1.0.tpk` — the native engine host

The UI starts the host by itself: no reboot, no manual start. Developer Mode must be enabled on the TV. Moving back from the older hybrid package? Uninstall it first (see the README).

The `-debug` variants are unoptimised builds with verbose logs from the UI, the .NET host and the engine — download these to report a problem.

## Known limitations

- **AV1 is not supported**: the TV's player on this firmware does not decode it.
- Not tested yet: HDR, keyboard / mouse input.
- No rumble, no surround sound (audio-io takes mono/stereo only; a 5.1 stream falls back to Web Audio, not tested), no shared A/V clock (audio and video run on separate clocks).
- Player stall recovery exists but is off by default until validated.
- Tested on one model so far (Tizen 5.0, Muse.M). Reports from other Tizen 5.0/5.5 TVs are welcome — attach the `ML-ERROR` line from a debug build.
